At one point around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an '''ancient frigate''' emerged, well-preserved by the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] but adrift and unresponsive, in the<ref name="TOR" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Kalki Nebula/Legends|Kalki Nebula]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
An individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the [[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] subsequently sent a companion to board the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in order to discover its origin. Upon boarding the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], the companion concluded that may have been a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] vessel. The companion downloaded information from the [[Navigator/Legends|navigation]] logs and retrieved some of the ship's preserved cargo.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The frigate was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' within the Crew Skill mission "A Forgotten Journey," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
